title: Coda418 - The Return of C418's Soundtrack
description: Adds unused mineraft tracks by C418 to the game and removes all new music that was not composed by C418.
body:
![The title card reading "Coda418"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e7ef4732fba0e027ffce3996a669ea4e4430fdb.png)

**◼ Please read the disclaimer at the bottom before installing ◼**
____________________________________________________________________________
**◼ About:**
This resource pack removes the new music introduced in the newest versions and brings back C418’s soundtrack by removing biome locked songs and implementing some of his unused music.

**◼ Settings:**

⚙️ Set your music frequency to "frequent" or “constant” in the audio settings for the best experience. (See “issues” at the bottom for more details)

⚠️ Please note that the music frequency option is only available on version 1.21.6 or newer.
____________________________________________________________________________

**◼ Added Tracks:**

Overworld:
- Eleven   [C418 - Volume Beta - Track 25](https://youtu.be/IVlOByjuE0c?si=Qc94dpTAaO3OX7ZV)
- Équinoxe   [C418 - Volume Alpha - Track 10](https://youtu.be/VkynjYWG9ac?si=DTBtV3eLV9Q0gGtA)
- Excuse   [C418 - Volume Alpha - Track 17](https://youtu.be/qmFedaouEK4?si=mHiSldUYMKF-dMLn)
- Flake   [C418 - Volume Beta - Track 05](https://youtu.be/7FiPwdmyFps?si=-3ppDhXSCEbzf-n7)
- Intro   [C418 - Volume Beta - Track 30](https://youtu.be/J1wZma12aXY?si=-68Xx9u0xPhwEgQV)
- Ki   [C418 - Volume Beta - Track 01](https://youtu.be/92nm3GdTc8E?si=PAZpM1bldeqK0tmM)
- Kyoto   [C418 - Volume Beta - Track 14](https://youtu.be/skvmfuYLZqU?si=trhKoeuZlMibBmbG)

Nether:
- Excuse   [C418 - Volume Alpha - Track 17](https://youtu.be/qmFedaouEK4?si=mHiSldUYMKF-dMLn)
- Halloween 2   [C418 - Halloween Mashup Pack (2015)](https://youtu.be/HDDAJWBGQjQ?si=2cpzv3o8qFZU0AFG)
____________________________________________________________________________

**◼ Features:**
- All music can play in all biomes (with some exceptions)

- Full support for the “now playing” music toast setting added in 1.21.6

- The music already used in game is more likely to play than the added unused tracks

- The Aquatic Update tracks Dragon Fish, Shuniji and Axolotl can only play in aquatic biomes. While standard Overworld tracks can also be triggered in these biomes, the aquatic tracks have a higher chance of playing.

- Ancestry is the only new song not removed in this pack and can only play in the deep dark biome
____________________________________________________________________________

**◼ Issues:**
- Even with my best efforts, Minecraft still forces the new songs to play periodically. To counteract this, all new tracks were replaced with a blank sound file which results in music sometimes playing less frequently in game when Minecraft decides to trigger one of the empty files.
I’m fairly new to coding like this so If you know a fix for this please [dm me on Discord](https://discord.gg/pvxDKjRHv) and I'll see what I can do. I recommend setting your music frequency to “frequent” or “constant” in-game if this bothers you.
- Because Minecraft still triggers all new music, the music toasts (when the option is enabled) will still appear but are set to appear blank without the title or author to fix the immersion as much as possible. To my knowledge, there isn’t a way to fully remove these toasts for new music only.

**◼ Note:**
- This pack is not intended to discredit the music composed by Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, Kumi Tanioka, Samuel Åberg, and Amos Roddy. I believe the addition of their music to the game fits Minecraft’s newer updates and style and does a good job of expanding the overall soundtrack and atmosphere. This project exists simply to allow players the option to experience C418’s music on its own, whether that be out of nostalgia, or simply preference.
____________________________________________________________________________

**⚠️ Disclaimer:**
This resource pack includes files containing music composed by Daniel Rosenfeld (C418) that are not included in the base game. All music remains the property of its copyright holder. 

This project is non-commercial and intended solely for artistic appreciation purposes inside of Minecraft. Redistribution without crediting C418 is strictly prohibited. You may use this pack in projects such as modpacks as long as:

- Credit is clearly given to C418 with a disclaimer statement similar to this one.

- A link back to this project page is included.

Any requests from the rights holder for this content to be modified or removed will be respected and acted upon.
